svg.text: Scale: 3 units = 1 inch. Furniture sizes are suggestions to refine with your carpenter.
NORTH WALL – m14 to m11a (looking north)
• arched alcove, warm LED cove light
• optional jali or glass folding doors
• tiered steps for idols: about chest
height standing, above eye level seated
• base: 2 drawers + 2 doors for puja items
• 24" deep, protrudes west into the room
Notes: 8' ceiling assumed · trophy cabinet and console 12" deep · console ends 6" before the mandir so the space in front of the mandir stays usable
· mandir faces west, so you face east while praying · put mandir, jali and trophy lights on separate dimmable circuits
